scope: Hold original STY leader fixed; never redefine the source laboratory champion after engineering feasibility filter.

category_definitions.original_sty_leader_feasible: At least two eligible designs, including an original raw STY top-ranked entry; the original top-STY candidate is compared to the cheapest feasible candidate.
category_definitions.original_sty_leader_infeasible: At least two feasible designs but NONE of the original STY top-ranked entries remains feasible; a redefined STY leader is a different question.
category_definitions.one_feasible_candidate: Exactly one feasible design; rank correlation or reversal cannot be tested.

caveats: Only source-anchored equipment ratios and first-order m surrogate; still no independently calibrated packed-bed pressure-drop.
An original STY champion that is infeasible is not evidence that process/economic rankings agree.
The 3-inlet intersection is conditional on the same group being comparable under all three envelope definitions.
Bootstrap resamples papers from the eligible subset; selection and physics-model uncertainty are not captured.
DOI is not always independent catalyst physics; two space-velocity groups in one article are not two independent papers.
